# Project Configuration

## Rules
- One `specd.yaml` drives CLI, MCP, plugins: schema, workspaces, storage, artifact constraints, graph, context, privacy, approvals, plugins.
- Discovery order:
  1. `--config path` selects only that file plus its `extends` chain. Normal filename discovery MUST NOT add layers. `--config` is explicit file entrypoint, never repository root selector.
  2. Walk up from CWD, or from host-supplied discovery root when bootstrap API passes one. Stop at first directory with any candidate, or at VCS root (nearest ancestor with `.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`, or active VCS adapter). None before/at VCS root → error.
  3. No VCS ancestor → check CWD only; do not walk up.
- Never search above VCS root. Host discovery-root mode stays distinct from `--config`. Some command families MAY bootstrap without project config; `--config` meaning unchanged.
- Candidate order in selected directory: `specd.yaml`; `specd.*.yaml` ascending alphabetical; `specd.local.yaml`; `specd.local.*.yaml` ascending alphabetical.
- No `extends` → standalone root. `extends: true` inherits previous active layer. `extends: <path>` activates only when that base is already in same chain; else ignored during normal discovery.
- Cascade: later layers win scalars, deep-merge objects, append arrays unless `remove`. `extends` is exactly `true` or one same-chain path. `remove` valid only when `extends` declared. Standalone root MUST NOT declare `remove`.
- `remove` is structural, not document-wide: `remove.root` drops optional top-level fields by name; `remove.<mapName>` drops keys from keyed maps (`workspaces`, `storage`); `remove.<arrayName>` drops inherited entries by that array identity. No arbitrary field-combination or AST-wide selectors. Required fields such as `schema` MUST NOT be removable.
- Identity v1: `context[]` optional `id` is preferred removal identity; `plugins.agents[]` identity is `name`; keyed maps use object keys.
- `specd.local.yaml` without `extends` is independent root (`specd.yaml` not inherited); with `extends: true` it inherits previous active layer. Local variants stay filename-ordered, e.g. `specd.local.10-team.yaml`, `specd.local.20-machine.yaml`, `specd.local.99-final.yaml`; last active local layer wins.
- `specd init` adds `specd.local.yaml` and `specd.local.*.yaml` to `.gitignore`.
- Optional `privacy`: `mode` MUST be `hash|mask|anonymous`; `salt` optional HMAC string (env recommended); `excludeActors` defaults `["specd", "system@getspecd.dev"]`; `allowedMetadataKeys` optional whitelist.
- Root non-hierarchical values overridable by env, including `.env` and `.env.local`, which beat `specd.yaml` and `specd.local.yaml`: `SPECD_ACTOR_PROVIDER` → `actorProvider`; `SPECD_PRIVACY_SALT` → `privacy.salt`; `SPECD_PRIVACY_MODE` → `privacy.mode`.
- Optional root `actorProvider` string forces that named kernel-registry provider and bypasses auto-detection.
- Required `schema`: exactly one project schema; no per-workspace schema selection. Prefix is exact; no implicit fallback. `SchemaRegistry.resolve()` receives full value:
  - `@scope/name` → `node_modules/@scope/name/schema.yaml`; npm version via `package.json`
  - `#workspace:name` → `workspaces.<workspace>.schemas` path `/<name>/schema.yaml`
  - `#name` or bare name → `#default:name` from `default` workspace `schemas`
  - relative or absolute path to `schema.yaml`; relative resolved from directory containing `specd.yaml`
- Resolve at command dispatch, immediately before command body. Skip for `--help`, `--version`, `init`, `config validate`, and `plugin` subcommands.
- `ConfigValidationError` (malformed `specd.yaml`) and `SchemaNotFoundError` / `SchemaValidationError` (resolution) are distinct `@specd/core` `SpecdError` subtypes, messages, and exit codes.
- Optional root `invalidationPolicy`: `none|surgical|downstream|global`. Seeds new changes and fills effective policy when a change is not overridden later.
- Optional `schemaPlugins[]` uses same reference convention as `schema`. Applied as merge layers after base schema `extends` chain, declaration order. Each file MUST have `kind: schema-plugin`. `kind: schema` → `SchemaValidationError`. Unresolved → `SchemaNotFoundError`.
- Optional `schemaOverrides` applied after all plugins. Ops `create|remove|set|append|prepend` all optional; same semantics as `mergeSchemaLayers` (`core:schema-merge`). Structural shape validated at startup; semantic checks (e.g. remove missing entry) at schema resolution.
- `workspaces` required and nonempty. `default` reserved and required; `specd init` creates it when `workspaces` absent. `root` reserved for code-graph project-global resources; workspace named `root` → `ConfigValidationError`.
- Workspace fields: optional `prefix`; required `specs` with `adapter` (v1 only `"fs"`); optional `schemas` adapter; `codeRoot`; `ownership` `owned|shared|readOnly`.
- `specs.adapter.config.path` required for `fs`; relative paths from directory containing `specd.yaml`. Path outside repo root → application sets `RepositoryConfig.isExternal` true.
- `specs.adapter.config.metadataPath` optional. When declared, loader resolves it relative to config directory and retains absolute path on workspace specs adapter binding. Kernel composition MUST prefer that retained value when wiring `SpecRepository`. When absent, deriving `metadataPath` from VCS root of `specs.adapter.config.path` + `/.specd/metadata/` (or `.specd/metadata/` relative to specs path parent when not inside any VCS) belongs to kernel composition, NOT `config-loader.load()`.
- `schemas` optional. Omitted on `default` → `adapter: { type: fs, config: { path: .specd/schemas } }`. Omitted on non-`default` → no local schemas; reference such as `#billing:name` → `SchemaNotFoundError`.
- `codeRoot`: `default` defaults to project root (directory containing `specd.yaml`); non-`default` required, no default. `CompileContext` uses it as where to write code.
- `ownership`: `owned` may create, modify, archive (default for `default`); `shared` modifiable, external teams may also modify; `readOnly` context only, changes cannot target (default for non-`default`).
- Workspace MAY declare `context.includeSpecs` and `context.excludeSpecs`. Pattern section and examples use `contextIncludeSpecs` and `contextExcludeSpecs` at project top level and inside workspace entries. Same pattern syntax. Project patterns always apply; workspace patterns apply only when that workspace is active.
- Workspace active when change metadata lists at least one of its specs. `CompileContext` resolves workspace by matching spec path to declared `specs.fs.path` or `specs.adapter.config.path`. Not filesystem scan, not CWD, not `codeRoot`.
- `*` only alone (`*`), sole suffix after `workspace:` (`billing:*`), or sole suffix after path prefix ending `/` (`_global/*`). Not mid-segment.
- Pattern meaning. Project omit-qualifier ≡ `default:`. Workspace omit-qualifier ≡ this workspace.
  - `*` project: all specs all workspaces. Workspace: all specs in this workspace (`{self}:*`).
  - `workspace:*` all specs in named workspace.
  - `prefix/*` project: under `prefix/` in `default`. Workspace: under `prefix/` in this workspace.
  - `workspace:prefix/*` under `prefix/` in named workspace.
  - `path/name` exact spec, no descendants. Project → `default`. Workspace → this workspace.
  - `workspace:path/name` exact spec ID in named workspace, no descendants.
- Defaults: project `contextIncludeSpecs` `['default:*']`; project `contextExcludeSpecs` `[]`; workspace `contextIncludeSpecs` `['*']` (`{workspace-name}:*`); workspace `contextExcludeSpecs` `[]`.
- `CompileContext` order: (1) project `context` entries, declaration order, always before spec content, injected as-is, not deduped against specs; (2) project includes, declaration order; (3) project excludes remove from step 2; (4) active-workspace includes, workspace declaration order then pattern order; (5) active-workspace excludes, same order; (6) transitive `dependsOn` from change `specIds` via `change.specDependsOn`, then `.specd-metadata.yaml`, then content extraction, until no new specs. Step 6 ignores excludes from steps 3 and 5. Earlier match wins on truncation. Multi-include appears once at first match. Step 6 specs already in steps 2–5 stay at earlier position. See `core:spec-metadata` for `.specd-metadata.yaml`.
- Unknown workspace qualifier: startup warning, startup continues. `specd config validate` MUST error. Non-existent spec IDs skipped at compile time. Invalid pattern syntax errors at startup. `specd config validate` warns when any include/exclude pattern matches no specs on disk; not a runtime error.
- Optional project-only `contextMode`: `'list'` spec IDs and source metadata, no descriptions or content; `'summary'` (default) spec ID, title, description, no full content; `'full'` all collected specs full content; `'hybrid'` direct change specs full when caller includes them, other collected specs as summaries. `'lazy'` removed; MUST NOT alias `hybrid`. Inside a workspace → unknown field, startup reject. Omitted → `'summary'`.
- Optional `context[]`. Each entry one of `{ instruction: string }`, `{ file: string }`, `{ id: string, instruction: string }`, `{ id: string, file: string }`. `id` optional stable inherited-removal identity. `file` relative to directory of active config file unless already absolute.
- `approvals.spec` default false. `true`: `ready` cannot go straight to `implementing`; must `pending-spec-approval`, explicit approval with identity, reason, timestamp, then `spec-approved`, then `implementing`. `false`: `ready → implementing` free.
- `approvals.signoff` default false. `true`: `done` cannot go straight to `archivable` even for additions only; must `pending-signoff`, explicit sign-off, `signed-off → archivable`. Record covers new, modified, and removed specs. `false`: `done → archivable` free. Flags independent.
- Optional `logging.level`: `trace|debug|info|warn|error|silent`; default `info`. Omitted `logging` → built-in defaults.
- Optional `llmOptimizedContext` boolean, default false. `true`: LLM may enrich output (metadata: richer `description`, structured `given`/`when`/`then`, more precise `dependsOn`). `false` or absent: deterministic parse of `spec.md` and `verify.md` only.
- `plugins` validated by Zod at load; structural errors → `ConfigValidationError` before any command. Shape: `plugins.agents?: Array<{ name: string; config?: Record<string, unknown> }>`. Unknown plugin types rejected. `name` required; `config` optional.
- `ConfigWriter` port: `initProject(options: InitProjectOptions): Promise<InitProjectResult>`; `addPlugin(configPath: string, type: string, name: string, config?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void>` adds to `plugins.<type>`, MUST NOT duplicate; `removePlugin(configPath: string, type: string, name: string): Promise<void>`; `listPlugins(configPath: string, type?: string): Promise<Array<{ name: string; config?: Record<string, unknown> }>>` (omit `type` → all).
- Startup MUST `ConfigValidationError` when: `remove` without `extends`; `extends` not `true` or string path; `extends: <path>` outside applicable chain; `remove.root` deletes required field such as `schema`; `remove.workspaces` or `remove.storage` names a key absent from inherited base; array removal cannot resolve exactly one inherited target. Surface via `SpecdError` / `ConfigValidationError`.
- Legacy-compatible shapes emit nonfatal `SpecdConfig.warnings` during load, preserved on resolved config for host bootstrap. Legacy workspace spec adapter format still resolves and warns for `'workspaces.default.specs'`. Omitting `storage` MUST NOT warn for storage.
- Optional `storage`. Each binding: `adapter.type` plus `adapter.config`. `SpecdStorageConfig` exposes raw `changesAdapter`, `draftsAdapter`, `discardedAdapter`, `archiveAdapter` (`SpecdAdapterBinding`) and absolute `changesPath`, `draftsPath`, `discardedPath`, `archivePath`.
- Omitted `storage` or omitted binding → `ConfigLoader` default `fs`: `storage.changes` `<specdPath>/changes`; `storage.drafts` `<specdPath>/drafts`; `storage.discarded` `<specdPath>/discarded`; `storage.archive` `<specdPath>/archive`.
- Named storage adapter: adapter-specific config passed through as adapter-owned. Name absent from merged built-in plus external storage registries MUST fail clearly.
- Optional `specdPath`, default `.specd` relative to directory containing `specd.yaml`. In-memory `SpecdConfig`: `specdPath` absolute data dir; `configPath` absolute `<specdPath>/config`. Derived: `{specdPath}/graph`; `{specdPath}/tmp`; `{configPath}/tmp/change-locks`.
- Loader MUST verify every resolved absolute directory in `SpecdConfig` (`specdPath`, storage staging paths, workspace paths). Missing → `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
- `TemplateExpander` expands `{{namespace.key}}` in archive patterns and hook commands. Unmatched token kept unchanged; warning names token; informational, does not halt.
- Every `graph` path/pattern at project level and `workspaces.<name>.graph` is project-root-relative (directory containing `specd.yaml`). Keys: `includePaths`, `excludePaths`, `allowedPaths`, `testPaths`, `ignorePaths`, `largeFilePaths`. Project-relative path uses `/`, no leading `./` or `/`. Leading `/` or internal `/` anchors at project root. Workspace pattern limits which owned files it applies to; it is NOT relative to that workspace `codeRoot`. Unanchored (no `/` except trailing, e.g. `*.spec.ts`, `node_modules/`) matches any depth. Same interpretation for project-global discovery, workspace discovery, indexing, graph input visibility, graph health, path explanation. Project-relative path starting `../` (`codeRoot` outside project root): anchored patterns cannot match; unanchored matched against path below `codeRoot`; not a config error. Absolute paths invalid in these keys. `codeRoot` and storage `path` stay relative to directory containing `specd.yaml`. Earlier `codeRoot`-relative workspace graph configs are NOT migrated or warned; no compatibility switch.
- `.gitignore` keeps hierarchical semantics from the `.gitignore` file location and absolute priority when `respectGitignore` is `true`.
- Workspace `graph.respectGitignore` default `true`. `true`: load `.gitignore` from git root → directories to `codeRoot` → `codeRoot` → subdirectories; `excludePaths` cannot re-include a gitignored file. `false`: do not load `.gitignore`; only `excludePaths`.
- Workspace `graph.allowedPaths`: optional project-relative globs. If set, only owned files whose project-relative path matches are indexed.
- Workspace `graph.excludePaths`: gitignore-syntax, `!` negation. Separate from global layer (project `graph.excludePaths` plus repository-derived spec-root exclusions). Global exclusion stays excluded; workspace `!` MUST NOT re-include it. Workspace `!` only reverses earlier workspace-list patterns. Unspecified → built-in defaults `node_modules/`, `.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`, `.specd/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `.next/`, `.nuxt/`. Specified → replaces built-ins entirely; no merge.
- Workspace `graph.testPaths` and `graph.ignorePaths` supplement project lists for files owned by that workspace. `graph.maxFileBytes` replaces project value for owned files. `graph.largeFilePaths` added to project `graph.largeFilePaths`.
- Project `graph.includePaths`: optional globs for project-global files outside workspace-owned graph identities. Assign reserved `root:` only when not already owned by a configured workspace `codeRoot`.
- Project `graph.excludePaths` apply to project-global discovery and every workspace discovery, same project-relative path. Workspace filters MAY add restrictions; MUST NOT remove or override global exclusions.
- Project `graph.testPaths` omitted defaults `['**/*.spec.*', '**/*.test.*', '**/test/**', '**/tests/**', '**/__tests__/**', '*_test.*']`. Project `graph.ignorePaths` omitted defaults `[]`.
- Project `testPaths` / `ignorePaths` plus owning-workspace lists form one ordered list, project patterns first, matched on project-relative path. Workspace `!` can cancel a project pattern of the same kind. `largeFilePaths` lists stay separate; exempt when either matches; workspace `!` cannot cancel a project exemption.
- Categorization precedence: (1) `excludePaths` or `.gitignore` → not read or indexed; (2) `ignorePaths` → `ignored`; (3) `testPaths` → `test`; (4) else `source`.
- `maxFileBytes` MUST be non-negative integer. Negative, non-integer, or non-number → startup config error. `0` disables limit. Absent at both levels → field absent; code graph built-in default 262144 bytes (256 KiB). Workspace value REPLACES project value for owned files.
- `largeFilePaths`: gitignore-syntax, `!` within same list, project-root-relative. Size-limit exemption only. MUST NOT index a file excluded by `excludePaths`, `allowedPaths`, `.gitignore`, or binary filter. Cascade: later scalar wins; arrays append.

## Constraints
- Strict Zod at load; unknown top-level fields rejected.
- `privacy.mode` `hash` requires salt via config or env, else validation fails.
- Discovery never goes above VCS root.
- Cascade `ConfigValidationError` blocks startup. `SpecdConfig.warnings` do not.
- One active schema. `contextMode` is project-level only.
- Graph patterns are project-root-relative. Global exclusions cannot be negated by workspace patterns.
- `maxFileBytes` non-negative integer; `0` disables; absent both levels leaves code-graph default 262144.
- Missing resolved directory → `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
